subject: TypeError: Cannot read property 'token' of undefined in @scalekit-sdk/node
snippet: Getting an error after upgrading to 2.5.0
body:
Hi,

After upgrading @scalekit-sdk/node to 2.5.0 I'm getting this error in my TypeScript project:

```
TypeError: Cannot read property 'token' of undefined
    at ScalekitClient.init (/node_modules/@scalekit-sdk/node/dist/index.js:42:18)
    at async bootstrap (/src/app.ts:15:3)
```

This worked fine on 2.4.1. Node.js 20.10, TypeScript 5.3.

Steps to reproduce:
1. npm install @scalekit-sdk/node@2.5.0
2. Initialize client with valid env vars
3. Call connectedAccounts.getOrCreateConnectedAccount

Is there a known fix?

Thanks
